CurrencyOverlayDescription.message:
Allows you to add additional currencies to your UI Overlay.

Additionally allows you to set minimum and maximum values to trigger a warning.

WondrousTailsProbabilitiesDescription.message: Displays current line probabilities and average reroll probabilities in the Wondrous Tails Book.

WindowBackgroundsDescription.message:
Allows you to add a background to any native window.

Examples: Cast Bar, Target Health Bar, Inventory Widget, Todo List.

TargetCastBarCountdownDescription.message: Adds the time remaining for your targets current cast to the cast bar.

SuppressDialogAdvanceDescription.message: Prevents advancing a cutscene dialogue, unless you click on the dialogue box itself.

StickyShopCategoriesDescription.message: Remembers the previously selected category when opening shops, retainer markets, grand company vendors, etc.

SkipTeleportConfirmDescription.message: Skips the 'Teleport to [Location] for [amount] gil?' popup when using the map to teleport.

SaddlebagSearchBarDescription.message: Adds a search bar to the saddlebag window.

RetainerSearchBarDescription.message: Adds a search bar to the retainer window.

ResetInventoryTabDescription.message: Automatically resets the inventory to the first tab when opened.

MiniCactpotHelperDescription.message: Indicates which Mini Cactpot spots you should reveal next.

MacroTooltipsDescription.message: Displays action tooltips when hovering over a macro with '/macroicon' set with an 'action'

MacroLineNumbersDescription.message: Adds line numbers to the User Macros window.

InventorySearchBarDescription.message: Adds a search bar to the inventory window.

ArmourySearchBarDescription.message: Adds a search bar to the armoury window.

LocationDisplayDescription.message: Displays your current location in the server information bar.

LocationFormatInstruction.message:
Use the text box below to define how you want the text to be formatted.
Use symbols {0} {1} {2} {3} {4} where you want the following values to be in the string

{0} - Region (Ex. The Northern Empty)
{1} - Territory (Ex. Old Sharlayan)
{2} - Area (Ex. Archons Design)
{3} - Sub-Area (Ex. Old Sharlayan Aetheryte Plaza)
{4} - Housing Ward (Ex. Ward 14)

HUDCoordinatesDescription.message:
Display coordinate positions in HUD Layout nodes, allows you get get things exactly right.

Displays coordinates of the center of HUD elements.

FateListWindowDescription.message: Displays a list of all fates that are currently active in the current zone

DutyTimerDescription.message: When completing a duty, prints the time the duty took to chat.

ListInventoryDescription.message: Adds a window that displays your inventory as a list, with toggleable filters.

GearsetRedirectDescription.message: When equipping gearsets, set alternative sets to load depending on what zone you are in.

ClearFlagDescription.message: Allows you to right click the minimap to clear the currently set flag marker.

FasterScrollDescription.message: Increases the speed of all scrollbars.

ResourceBarPercentagesDescription.message: Displays HP, MP, GP and CP bars as percentages instead of raw values.

FadeLootButtonDescription.message: Fades the Loot button if you've already rolled on everything available.

FadeUnavailableActionsDescription.message:
Fades hotbar slots when the action is not able to be cast due to missing resources, out of range, or just on cooldown.

Additionally fades actions that are not available because you are sync'd down.

BetterCursorDescription.message: Draws a ring around the cursor to make it easier to see

FastMouseClickDescription.message:
The game does not fire UI events for single mouse clicks whenever a double click is detected.

This game modification fixes it by always triggering the normal mouse click in addition to the double click.

SelectNextLootItemDescription.message:
Automatically advance to the next loot item after clicking Need, Greed, or Pass.

Note: this modification does not automatically roll on loot.

ClearTextInputsDescription.message: Allows you to clear the text in a text input, by right clicking the text input.

ClearSelectedDutiesDescription.message: When opening the Duty Finder, deselects any selected duties.

HUDPresetsDescription.message: Provides preset HUD layouts that can be quickly applied.

WorkInProgressDeletePreset.message:
Work in Progress
Manually delete preset files for now

ClickSaveAboveFirst.message: Click save above before saving a new preset

SaveCurrentUIAsNewPreset.message: Save Current UI as a new preset

HideUnwantedBannersDescription.message: Prevents large text banners from appearing and playing their sound effect.

HideGuildhestObjectivePopupDescription.message:
When starting a guildhest this modification will prevent the popup window that contains the instructions on how to do the Guildhest.

You will still receive the chat message with the guildhest explanation.

BetterQuestMapLinkDescription.message: When clicking on quest links, open the actual map the quest is for instead of the generic world map.

EnhancedLootWindowDescription.message: Adds indicators to loot window items to indicate if you have unlocked that item before, or if the item is obtainable.

MissingJobStoneLockoutDescription.message: Prevents queuing for a duty while you are missing a jobstone.

OpenGlamourDresserToCurrentJob.message: Open Glamour Dresser to Current Job

OpenGlamourDresserToCurrentJobDescriptio.message: When opening the glamour dresser, the tab for your current job will be automatically selected.

PartyFinderPresetsDescription.message: Allows you to save an use presets for the Party Finder Recruitment window

SaveCurrentSettingsToPreset.message: [VanillaPlus]: Save current settings to a preset

PetSizeContextMenuDescription.message: When right clicking on a pet, or a player with a pet, show a context menu entry for changing the pet size

QuestListWindowDescription.message: Displays a list of all available quests for the currently occupied zone.

RecentlyLootedWindowDescription.message:
Adds a window that shows a scrollable list of all items that you have looted this session.

Filters exist to help you distinguish between what types of items you are after.

InstancedWaymarksDescription.message: Enables the use of all saved Waymark Slots per duty, instead of sharing them across all duties, with the option to name each slot.

HideMpBarsDescription.message: Hides MP Bars in party list for jobs that don't use MP.

ForcedCutsceneSoundsDescription.message: Automatically unmutes selected sound channels in cutscenes.

FocusTargetLockDescription.message: When a duty recommences, restores your previous focus target.

DraggableWindowDeadSpaceDescription.message: Allows clicking and dragging on window dead space to move the window.

CastBarAetheryteNamesDescription.message: Replaces the name of the action 'Teleport' with the Aetheryte name of your destination.

BetterInterruptableCastBarsDescription.message:
Makes enemy interruptable castbars much more noticeable.

Additionally skills that can interrupt the cast are indicated on your hotbar.
